title: Reuse exact canonical SparseTensorEntry coordinate tuples
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: SparseTensorEntry coordinate construction validated every bounded coordinate pair, then always materialized a list, sorted it, and returned a newly allocated tuple even when the caller had already supplied an exact immutable tuple-of-tuples in strict canonical axis order.
primary_claim: SparseTensorEntry coordinate canonicalization now returns an exact already-canonical tuple-of-tuples by identity after the existing validation/order pass. Inputs whose structure or axis order does not prove canonical reuse enter the existing materialize-and-sort fallback, and duplicate axis names remain fail-closed.
gardener_decision: Reuse exact immutable canonical caller data inside the existing _coordinate path rather than add a coordinate cache, helper index, parallel representation, or alternate Tensor abstraction. Keep one bounded validation pass and retain the existing sorting fallback only when canonical reuse cannot be proven.
acceptance: an exact canonical tuple-of-tuples is retained by object identity after SparseTensorEntry construction
every retained coordinate pair is still validated for axis identifier, label bounds and NUL refusal before reuse
non-canonical coordinate order still canonicalizes deterministically through the existing sort fallback
oversized and unsized coordinate inputs retain the existing bounded refusal behavior
